# Host profile: Claude Code

> Generated by `scripts/build.mjs` from `adapters/claude-code/platform.json`. Do not edit.
> Verification: **live**.

The rest of FORGE names capabilities, not tools. This page maps each one to this host. Use the native form for a `supported` capability.
For an `unsupported` one, use the fallback. Try an `unverified` one once, and if it fails, use the fallback and say so in the report. Never claim a capability this page doesn't list as supported.

**Models:** standard tier = `sonnet`, strong tier = `opus`.

| Capability | Status | On this host |
|---|---|---|
| entryCommand | supported | `/forge <request>`. The installer adds the standalone skill, so the command is bare; as a plugin it is `/forge:forge` |
| requestArguments | supported | `$ARGUMENTS` in SKILL.md |
| skillDir | supported | `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`, or the folder of the loaded SKILL.md |
| subagents | supported | `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: forge-<role>` (a plugin install namespaces it: `forge:forge-<role>`) |
| parallelSubagents | supported | several `Agent` calls in one message |
| foregroundWait | supported | `Agent`, `Bash` and `PowerShell` calls without `run_in_background` block until they finish (`timeout` up to 600000 ms for commands) |
| continueSubagent | supported | `SendMessage` to the agent's ID (load it with `ToolSearch` first if it is listed only by name) |
| perCallModel | supported | `model: "opus"` or `"sonnet"` on the `Agent` call; the agent file stays unchanged |
| toolRestriction | supported | `tools` / `disallowedTools` in agent frontmatter (read-only roles cannot edit) |
| gitGuardHook | supported | `PreToolUse` hook running `scripts/git-guard.mjs` on FORGE agents and the /forge skill |
| preApprovedScripts | supported | `allowed-tools` on the forge skill: reading `~/.claude/skills/forge*/**` and `node` on FORGE's own script folders. It holds only for the turn that ran `/forge` |
| userQuestion | supported | `AskUserQuestion` from the main thread (`multiSelect: true` to pick several) |
| deferredTools | supported | `ToolSearch` with `select:<tool>,<tool>` before calling a tool that is listed only by name |
| browserTools | supported | Playwright MCP and Chrome DevTools MCP (`claude mcp add …`); each tool call follows the user's permission rules |
| backgroundCommands | supported | `run_in_background: true`. The result arrives in a later turn, which no longer has the skill's pre-approvals, so FORGE never uses it for its own work |

**Required configuration:**
- Install with `scripts/install.sh --target claude` (or `install.ps1 -Target claude`) for the bare `/forge` command.
- Optional, for browser QA: the Playwright and Chrome DevTools MCP servers (see docs/installation.md).

**Limitations:**
- A plugin install namespaces the command (`/forge:forge`) and the agents (`forge:forge-<role>`).
- Skill pre-approvals end with the `/forge` turn. A turn started later (for example by a background notification) asks for permission again.
- The git guard parses commands; a git alias or a script that runs git internally is not caught. Host deny rules add a layer (docs/security.md).
